Sect: Independent

The Old Clan @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} are a collection of disgruntled elders, along with a handful of outright lunatics and their loyal childer, who believe the modern @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} clan fell into delusion and rebellion when it embraced Vicissitude and tolerated the Anarch Revolt. They reject Vicissitude entirely, viewing it as a perversion unworthy of a true @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}, and some go further, branding it the manifestation of an evil spirit or vampiric disease; those who mock this belief have been purged as suspected members of a "Vicissitude conspiracy." A Tzimisce elder of the old ways should be a wise ruler steeped in ancient lore, not a shapeshifting freak, and most of the clan's remaining nights are spent preparing ancestral estates for what they believe are the coming End Times. In post-Communist Eastern Europe, many pose as returned nobility or business leaders, quietly restoring old-style feudal rule over the peasantry.

Disciplines: Animalism, Auspex, Dominate

Advantage: The Old Clan believes these three Disciplines reflect the true needs of ancient rulers - command over beasts, insight into their domains, and mastery over the minds of their subjects - and its members lean into rulership and lore rather than Vicissitude's fleshcrafting, making them exceptionally suited to quietly dominating an isolated domain or estate.

Disadvantage: Having rejected Vicissitude, the Old Clan Tzimisce lack its shapeshifting and regenerative benefits entirely, leaving them without the main clan's signature adaptability. Their obsession with purity and ancient hierarchy also breeds deep internal paranoia; purges and infighting between traditionalists and the lunatic faction regularly cost the bloodline members it can ill afford to lose.

Organization: Withdrawn almost entirely from wider Kindred society, the Old Clan cultivates isolated, virtuous domains on ancestral estates, particularly across Eastern Europe, rather than engaging with @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} or @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} politics. Some accept orphaned mortal sorcerer-servants (Rafastio) from the collapse of other cults, comfortable with a traditionalist, feudal arrangement.
